Notes

Packs are whole units, so a split rarely lands exactly on your pool. Whatever is left shows above. Roll it into a door prize, hold it for the season pot, or bump first place.

If two players tie for a spot, add that place and the one below it together and split it evenly. The calculator will not do that for you, but the per place values make it quick to work out.
